description: Full-time, remote. Most of what I do is automate work the company still handles manually. A Claude Code automation I built cut JSM ticket turnaround from two weeks to eight hours, which took real pressure off the team. Alongside that I'm moving services out of our own datacenters into GCP.

Joined right after the acquisition, when the whole AWS platform was still being built from scratch. Started with IP subnet design for every environment type and ended up operating it day to day against standards we wrote ourselves.
Moved the platform off VMs, where apps were deployed by running git pull, onto a properly set up GKE cluster.
Same company, different name back then. Spent two years building PHP apps, mostly Laravel.
A handful of contracts before I even finished school: simple websites, a Unity game, a Xamarin mobile app, an Electron desktop app, and a few bigger Laravel CMS projects.
